event_browser_check_response.title: Step 7: Reject a failed response
event_browser_check_response.prompt: Continue the same module project from the previous working step. In step 7 of 15, Problem: `fetch` can return a Response even when the local request failed, so decoding blindly could treat an error response as valid event data. Task: Keep the local request and add only the `response.ok` guard, throwing `Could not load events` when false. Expected result: successful requests continue; failed requests now reject before decoding.
